sub_indicators.label: People who own a mobile phone
sub_indicators.subject: infra.connect
sub_indicators.text: Mobile penetration: people who own a mobile phone
sub_indicators.norm_short: The African Union's Digital Transformation Strategy asks that every person be digitally empowered by 2030, with a device costing no more than USD 100. The International Telecommunication Union's 2030 target is that everyone aged 15 and over owns a mobile phone.
criteria: The latest figure, for 2024 or later, shows fewer than half of people aged 10 and over owning a mobile phone.

At least half of people aged 10 and over own a mobile phone: 50 per cent or more in the latest figure, for 2024 or later. A national survey or census is used where one is held, otherwise the International Telecommunication Union's estimate.
At least two in three own one: 65 per cent or more.
At least four in five own one: 80 per cent or more.
Nearly everyone owns one: 95 per cent or more. Counts of SIM cards and subscribers, and figures for adults only, are never used at any stage.
